examples.dm: They do not act as diviners, predicting whether those engaged in desire will have a boy or a girl. They strive in the supreme perfection of wisdom, which is utterly secluded, free from strife and contention, and their minds of loving-kindness are firm. Desiring omniscience, they are steadfast and possess a mind constantly dedicated to it.
examples.gm: They do not predict, saying, 'You will become a man or a woman engaged in actions of desire.' In the utterly isolated perfection of wisdom, they are free from conflict and dispute, and their mind of loving-kindness is firm. Desiring omniscience, they are steadfast and always endowed with a mind inclined toward it.
examples.sa: न च आदिशन्ति पुरुषैः स्त्रिय इच्छकर्मां प्रविविक्त प्रज्ञवरपारमिताभियुक्ताः । कलहाविवादविगता दृढमैत्रचित्ता सर्वज्ञकाम सद शासनि निम्नचित्ताः ॥

examples.dm: They have completely avoided the borderlands and the regions of barbarian peoples. They are never uncertain about their own stage, remaining as steadfast as Mount Meru. They would even sacrifice their lives for the sake of the Dharma and are devoted to the diligence of yoga. One should know that these are the signs of the state of non-retrogression.
examples.gm: They completely abandon the borderlands of uncivilized border-dwellers. Without self-doubt, they are always like Mount Sumeru. Giving up even their lives for the sake of the dharma, they vividly strive in yoga. One should know that these are the signs of an irreversible one.
examples.sa: प्रत्यन्तम्लेच्छजनवर्जित-अन्तदेशाः स्वकभूमि काङ्क्षविगताः सद मेरुकल्पाः । धर्मार्थ जीवित त्यजन्ति प्रयुक्तयोगा अविवर्तियान इमि लिङ्ग प्रजानितव्या ॥

examples.dm: Any bodhisattva who has become profound in that way, And who realizes this Dharma—the ultimate, unattached vehicle in which aggregates, Elements, and sense sources do not exist— What could there be that is a more perfect accomplishment of merit than that?
examples.gm: For any bodhisattva who realizes this profound Vehicle, ultimate and unattached, wherein the aggregates, Elements, and sense-sources do not exist— What perfectly accomplished merit is there beyond that?
examples.sa: यो बोधिसत्त्व इमु बुध्यति एव धर्मां गम्भीरयानपरमार्थनिरुपलेपान् । यस्मिन् न स्कन्ध न पि आयतनं न धातु किं वा स्वपुण्यसमुदागमु किंचि तस्य ॥

examples.dm: For example, consider a man who indulges in desire and, Having made an appointment with a woman, fails to meet her; However many conceptual thoughts he experiences in his mind throughout a single day, For that many eons, the bodhisattva will achieve attainment.
examples.gm: For example, a man who engages in the phenomena of desire, Having made an appointment with a woman and not meeting her, However many discursive thoughts of his mind operate in a single day, The bodhisattva will gain that many eons.
examples.sa: यथ रागधर्मचरितः पुरुषः स्त्रियाये संकेत कृत्व अलभन्तु विवर्तयेया । यावन्ति चित्तचरिता दिवसेन तस्य तावन्त कल्प अनुबुध्यति बोधिसत्त्वो ॥

examples.dm: Any bodhisattva who meditates on the supreme perfection of wisdom, And having arisen from that, teaches the stainless Dharma, And dedicates that for the sake of beings as the cause of enlightenment— There is no virtue in the three worlds equal to that.
examples.gm: Any bodhisattva who meditates on the supreme wisdom, Arising from that, teaches the untainted dharma, And dedicates that as a cause for awakening for the sake of beings, There is no virtue equal to that in the three worlds.
examples.sa: यो बोधिसत्त्व वरप्रज्ञ विभावयन्तो तत उत्थितो कथयि धर्म निरुपलेपम् । तं चापि नामयि जगार्थनिदान बोधौ नास्ति त्रिलोक शुभ तेन समं भवेया ॥

examples.dm: Know that such merit is also accumulated, and likewise empty, Hollow, insubstantial, and without essence. When one practices the wisdom of the Sugatas in that manner, At the time of practicing, one fully grasps immeasurable merit.
examples.gm: Knowing that merit, too, to be an accumulation and likewise empty, Hollow, baseless, and coreless— If one thus engages in the wisdom practice of the sugatas, While engaging, one fully grasps immeasurable merit.
examples.sa: तं चैव पुण्य पुन ख्यायति रिक्तमेव तथ शून्य तुच्छ वशिकं च असारकं च । एवं चरन्तु चरती सुगतान प्रज्ञां चरमाणु पुण्यु परिगृह्णति अप्रमेयम् ॥

examples.dm: Knowing that all these dharmas, which the Buddha has thoroughly practiced and clearly taught, Are exhausted as mere expressions, Even if one were to speak of them for many tens of billions of eons, The expanse of phenomena is without exhaustion and without increase.
examples.gm: Spoken by the Buddha, vividly practiced and vividly taught, Knowing all these dharmas to be nothing more than mere expressions, Even if they are expressed for many tens of millions and hundreds of billions of eons, In the dharmadhātu, there is no depletion and no increase.
examples.sa: अभिलापमात्र इम जानति सर्वधर्मां बुद्धेन देशित प्रयुक्त प्रकाशितांश् च । कल्पान कोटिनयुतां बहु भाषमाणो न च क्षीयते न च विवर्धति धर्मधातुः ॥

examples.dm: Whatever is called the perfection of the Victors, Those phenomena are also proclaimed to be merely names. A bodhisattva who dedicates without conceptual arrogance Will not decline and will touch the supreme awakening of a Buddha.
examples.gm: Whatever is called the perfection of the victors, Those dharmas too are fully proclaimed to be merely names. A bodhisattva who fully dedicates without a conceited mind Will without decline touch the supreme awakening of a buddha.
examples.sa: ये चापि पञ्च इमि पारमिता जिनानाम् एतेऽपि धर्म परिकीर्तित नाममात्राः । परिणामयाति न च मन्यति बोधिसत्त्वो न च हीयते स्पृशति उत्तमबुद्धबोधिम् ॥

examples.dm: Supreme enlightenment is not reached by the initial mind, Yet without that initial mind, it cannot be reached. Peaceful enlightenment is not attained by the final mind, Yet without that, it is also impossible to attain it.
examples.gm: By the first mind, supreme awakening is not touched, Yet without it, one is not able to touch it. By the final mind, peaceful awakening is not attained, Yet without it, one is not able to attain it.
examples.sa: प्रथमेव चित्त स्पृशती न च अग्रबोधिम् असता न तस्य स्पृशता पुन शक्य भोन्ति । न च चित्त पश्चिम शिवाम् अनुप्रापुणाति असता न तस्य पुन प्रापणनाय शक्यम् ॥

examples.dm: For example, a monk endowed with the supreme power of miracles Might remain in the sky and simultaneously display various transformations; He demonstrates walking, moving, lying down, and sitting, And he does not grow weary, nor does he become exhausted.
examples.gm: For example, a monk endowed with the supreme power of miracles, Abiding in space, simultaneously emanates magical creations, Demonstrating walking, pacing, sleeping, and sitting; He has no weariness, and he has no fatigue.
examples.sa: भिक्षू यथा परमऋद्धिबलेनुपेतो गगने स्थितो यमक कुर्वति प्रातिहार्यां । गतिचंक्रमं शयनिषद्य निदर्शयाति न निवर्तते न पि च खिद्यति याव तत्र ॥

examples.dm: For example, a monk endowed with the supreme power of miracles Might remain in the sky and simultaneously display various transformations; He demonstrates walking, moving, lying down, and sitting, And he does not grow weary, nor does he become exhausted.
examples.gm: For example, a monk endowed with the supreme power of miracles, Abiding in space, simultaneously emanates magical creations, Demonstrating walking, pacing, sleeping, and sitting; He has no weariness, and he has no fatigue.
examples.sa: भिक्षू यथा परमऋद्धिबलेनुपेतो गगने स्थितो यमक कुर्वति प्रातिहार्यां । गतिचंक्रमं शयनिषद्य निदर्शयाति न निवर्तते न पि च खिद्यति याव तत्र ॥

examples.dm: So too, the bodhisattva who has gone to the jewel island of emptiness, Having attained the meditative concentrations, faculties, and powers, Does not take delight in merely touching nirvana alone, And does not leave the suffering of sentient beings behind.
examples.gm: Likewise, a bodhisattva who has gone to the jewel island of emptiness, And attained the powers of the faculties of concentration, Does not merely delight in touching nirvāṇa, And leave sentient beings in suffering.
examples.sa: एमेव शून्यत व्रजित्वन रत्नद्वीपं लब्ध्वान ध्यान बल इन्द्रिय बोधिसत्त्वो । किंचापि निर्वृति स्पृशेदभिनन्दमानो अपि सर्वसत्त्व दुखिता मनसी भवन्ति ॥

examples.dm: If, having thoroughly inquired about their conduct and faculties, The bodhisattva does not fully demonstrate the dharmas of emptiness and signlessness, Nor explain the dharmas of the irreversible stage, One should understand that such a person has not been prophesied.
examples.gm: If, when completely questioned about their practice and faculties, A bodhisattva, the dharmas of emptiness and signlessness Does not completely teach, and the dharmas of the irreversible stage Does not explain, they should be known as unprophesied.
examples.sa: यदि पृच्छमान चरि इन्द्रिय बोधिसत्त्वो गम्भीरधर्मपरिदीपन नो करोति । शून्यानिमित्त अविवर्तियबोधिधर्मां न च शोचती न च स व्याकृतु वेदितव्यो ॥

examples.dm: If, having thoroughly inquired about their conduct and faculties, The bodhisattva does not fully demonstrate the dharmas of emptiness and signlessness, Nor explain the dharmas of the irreversible stage, One should understand that such a person has not been prophesied.
examples.gm: If, when completely questioned about their practice and faculties, A bodhisattva, the dharmas of emptiness and signlessness Does not completely teach, and the dharmas of the irreversible stage Does not explain, they should be known as unprophesied.
examples.sa: यदि पृच्छमान चरि इन्द्रिय बोधिसत्त्वो गम्भीरधर्मपरिदीपन नो करोति । शून्यानिमित्त अविवर्तियबोधिधर्मां न च शोचती न च स व्याकृतु वेदितव्यो ॥

examples.dm: The fifth chapter explains the clear realization of the pinnacle. One who does not desire the level of an Arhat, the wisdom of a Pratyekabuddha, Or the three realms, even in a dream, But sees the Buddhas and teaches the Dharma to beings— One should understand that this is the prophecy of non-retrogression.
examples.gm: Chapter Five: Teaching the Clear Realization of the Peak. The stage of an arhat and the pristine wisdom of a pratyekabuddha, And the three realms, they do not desire even in dreams; Seeing the buddhas and teaching the dharma to wanderers, They should be known as irreversible and prophesied.
examples.sa: अर्हन्तभूमिम् अपि प्रत्ययबुद्धभूमौ त्रैधातुकं न स्पृशते सुपिनान्तरेऽपि । बुद्धांश् च पश्यति कथेति जनस्य धर्मं अविवर्तियेति अयु व्याकृतु वेदितव्यो ॥

examples.dm: If, in a dream, one sees sentient beings dwelling in the three lower realms, And in that very moment makes a prayer to cut the continuum of the lower realms, And pacifies a mass of fire through the power of the blessing of truth— One should understand that this is the prophecy of non-retrogression.
examples.gm: In a dream, seeing sentient beings abiding in the three lower realms, In that instant they make aspirations to cut off the stream of the lower realms. Through the blessing of truth, the masses of fire are pacified; They should be known as irreversible and prophesied.
examples.sa: त्रि-अपायप्राप्तु सुपिनस्मि विदित्व सत्त्वान् प्रणिधेति तत्क्षण अपाय उच्छोषयेयम् । सत्याधिष्ठानि प्रशमेति स चाग्निस्कन्धम् अविवर्तियेति अयु व्याकृतु वेदितव्यो ॥

examples.dm: If, in a dream, one sees sentient beings dwelling in the three lower realms, And in that very moment makes a prayer to cut the continuum of the lower realms, And pacifies a mass of fire through the power of the blessing of truth— One should understand that this is the prophecy of non-retrogression.
examples.gm: In a dream, seeing sentient beings abiding in the three lower realms, In that instant they make aspirations to cut off the stream of the lower realms. Through the blessing of truth, the masses of fire are pacified; They should be known as irreversible and prophesied.
examples.sa: त्रि-अपायप्राप्तु सुपिनस्मि विदित्व सत्त्वान् प्रणिधेति तत्क्षण अपाय उच्छोषयेयम् । सत्याधिष्ठानि प्रशमेति स चाग्निस्कन्धम् अविवर्तियेति अयु व्याकृतु वेदितव्यो ॥

examples.dm: The many spirits and diseases in the human world Are pacified through the blessing of truth by those endowed with benefit and compassion; Yet they remain without conceit and do not give rise to pride— One should understand that this is the prophecy of non-retrogression.
examples.gm: In the human world, there are many bhūta demons and diseases; Possessing benefit and compassion, they pacify them through the blessing of truth. Yet they have no conceit and do not produce pride; They should be known as irreversible and prophesied.
examples.sa: भूतग्रहा विविध व्याधय मर्त्यलोके सत्याधिष्ठानि प्रशमेति हितानुकम्पी । न च तेन मन्यन् उपपद्यति नापि मानम् अविवर्तियेति अयु व्याकृतु वेदितव्यः ॥

examples.dm: The many spirits and diseases in the human world Are pacified through the blessing of truth by those endowed with benefit and compassion; Yet they remain without conceit and do not give rise to pride— One should understand that this is the prophecy of non-retrogression.
examples.gm: In the human world, there are many bhūta demons and diseases; Possessing benefit and compassion, they pacify them through the blessing of truth. Yet they have no conceit and do not produce pride; They should be known as irreversible and prophesied.
examples.sa: भूतग्रहा विविध व्याधय मर्त्यलोके सत्याधिष्ठानि प्रशमेति हितानुकम्पी । न च तेन मन्यन् उपपद्यति नापि मानम् अविवर्तियेति अयु व्याकृतु वेदितव्यः ॥

examples.dm: The many spirits and diseases in the human world Are pacified through the blessing of truth by those endowed with benefit and compassion; Yet they remain without conceit and do not give rise to pride— One should understand that this is the prophecy of non-retrogression.
examples.gm: In the human world, there are many bhūta demons and diseases; Possessing benefit and compassion, they pacify them through the blessing of truth. Yet they have no conceit and do not produce pride; They should be known as irreversible and prophesied.

examples.dm: Or if, because they have acquired various blessings of truth, They develop conceit, thinking, "I have been prophesied," Or if they become conceited because other bodhisattvas have received a prophecy, Know that those who abide in such conceit are of small intelligence.
examples.gm: However, if through those various blessings of truth Being accomplished, the conceit arises thinking, "I am prophesied," Or if a bodhisattva is conceited about being prophesied by another, Abiding in conceit, they should be known as having small intelligence.
examples.sa: अथवास्य मन्यन् उपपद्यति व्याकृतोऽस्मि सत्याधिष्ठान विविधानि समृद्ध्ययन्ति । यदि अन्य व्याकृतकु मन्यति बोधिसत्त्वो ज्ञातव्य मन्यनस्थितो अयु अल्पबुद्धिः ॥

examples.dm: "And such will be the nature of your future ascetic discipline and yoga; Your former qualities were also like this," he declares. Any bodhisattva who, upon hearing such words, becomes conceited, Should be known as one of small intelligence who has been instigated by Māra.
examples.gm: "Whatever ascetic practices, vows, and yogas you will possess, Your past qualities and conduct were also like this," he says. Whatever bodhisattva hears such words and becomes conceited, Should be known as fully incited by Māra and having small intelligence.
examples.sa: धुतवृत्त यादृशु स भेष्यति युक्तयोगी पूर्वं पि तुभ्य इमि आसि गुणोवरूपा । यो एव श्रुत्व अभिमन्यति बोधिसत्त्वो ज्ञातव्यु मारु पर्युत्थितु अल्पबुद्धिः ॥

examples.dm: Except for those who constantly dwell in villages, regions, and towns, Striving for awakening and the ripening of sentient beings, And who do not generate the desire for the state of an Arhat or Pratyekabuddha— This is what the Sugata calls the solitude of the [Buddha's] sons.
examples.gm: Constantly abiding in villages, provinces, and towns, Except for striving for awakening to mature sentient beings, They do not produce other desires for arhatship or pratyekabuddhahood; This is taught by the sons of the Sugata as being solitary.
examples.sa: ग्रामे च राष्ट्रि निगमे विहरन्ति नित्यं रहप्रत्ययानि स्पृहतां जनयन्ति तत्र । अन्यत्र सत्त्वपरिपाचनबोधियुक्ता एषो विवेकु कथितो सुगतात्मजानाम् ॥

examples.dm: Except for those who constantly dwell in villages, regions, and towns, Striving for awakening and the ripening of sentient beings, And who do not generate the desire for the state of an Arhat or Pratyekabuddha— This is what the Sugata calls the solitude of the [Buddha's] sons.
examples.gm: Constantly abiding in villages, provinces, and towns, Except for striving for awakening to mature sentient beings, They do not produce other desires for arhatship or pratyekabuddhahood; This is taught by the sons of the Sugata as being solitary.
examples.sa: ग्रामे च राष्ट्रि निगमे विहरन्ति नित्यं रहप्रत्ययानि स्पृहतां जनयन्ति तत्र । अन्यत्र सत्त्वपरिपाचनबोधियुक्ता एषो विवेकु कथितो सुगतात्मजानाम् ॥

examples.dm: Even if one dwells for many millions of years in a mountain cleft Five hundred yojanas wide and filled with snakes, A bodhisattva who does not understand this solitude Will fall into arrogance and remain in a state of distraction.
examples.gm: Whoever, in a mountain valley of five hundred yojanas, Filled with snakes, abides for many ten millions of years, That bodhisattva who does not know this solitude, Having acquired superior pride, abides in mixture.
examples.sa: यो पञ्चयोजनशते गिरिकन्दरेषु व्यालावकीर्णि निवसेद्बहुवर्षकोटी । नो चा विवेकु इमु जानति बोधिसत्त्वो संकीर्ण सो विहरते अधिमानप्राप्तः ॥

examples.dm: A bodhisattva who strives for the benefit of beings and has attained meditative concentration, Powers, faculties, liberations, and absorptions—if one treats them with contempt, Thinking, "This person does not practice in forest isolation," The Victor has declared that such a person dwells within the domain of Māra.
examples.gm: When a bodhisattva striving for the benefit of beings attains dhyāna, Powers, faculties, liberations, and samādhi, If one despises them, thinking, "This is not the conduct of isolated monasteries," The Victorious One says they abide in the domain of Māra.
examples.sa: सो चंक्रमार्थम् अभियुक्तकबोधिसत्त्वान् बलध्यान-इन्द्रियविमोक्षसमाधिप्राप्तान् । अभिमन्यते न इमि रण्यविवेकचारी न विवेकगोचरु अयं हि जिनेन उक्तो ॥

examples.dm: A bodhisattva who strives for the benefit of beings and has attained meditative concentration, Powers, faculties, liberations, and absorptions—if one treats them with contempt, Thinking, "This person does not practice in forest isolation," The Victor has declared that such a person dwells within the domain of Māra.
examples.gm: When a bodhisattva striving for the benefit of beings attains dhyāna, Powers, faculties, liberations, and samādhi, If one despises them, thinking, "This is not the conduct of isolated monasteries," The Victorious One says they abide in the domain of Māra.
examples.sa: सो चंक्रमार्थम् अभियुक्तकबोधिसत्त्वान् बलध्यान-इन्द्रियविमोक्षसमाधिप्राप्तान् । अभिमन्यते न इमि रण्यविवेकचारी न विवेकगोचरु अयं हि जिनेन उक्तो ॥

examples.dm: Whether one dwells in a town or in a forest, If one is free from the mind of the two vehicles and is certain of supreme enlightenment, This is the solitude of those who have entered into the service of beings; Any bodhisattva who feels superior to them has degraded themselves.
examples.gm: Whether abiding in a village or else in an isolated monastery, If free from the minds of the two vehicles and certain of supreme awakening, This is the solitude of those engaged in the benefit of beings; That conceited bodhisattva ruins themselves.
examples.sa: ग्रामान्ति यो विहरते अथवा अरण्ये द्वययानचित्तविगतो नियतोऽग्रबोधिम् । एषो विवेकु जगदर्थभिप्रस्थितानां आत्मा क्षिणोति तुलयेय स बोधिसत्त्वो ॥

examples.dm: Therefore, those who seek supreme enlightenment, Being wise and possessing intense resolve, should utterly conquer pride; Just as a multitude of the sick rely on a physician for healing, One should rely on a spiritual friend without any distraction.
examples.gm: Therefore, one who seeks holy awakening, A wise one possessing strong intention, having definitely destroyed pride, Just as a multitude of sick people rely on a doctor to be cured, Should rely on spiritual friends without wavering.
examples.sa: तस्मा हु मानु निहनित्वन पण्डितेन गुरुआशयेन वरबोधि गवेषमाणः । वैद्यो व आतुर स्वरोगचिकित्सनार्थं कल्याणमित्र भजितव्य अतन्द्रितेन ॥

examples.dm: Bodhisattvas who have entered the supreme awakening of a Buddha Should rely on the perfections as their spiritual friends. Those who provide such instruction are the ground of accomplishment; Through these two causes, the awakening of a Buddha is swiftly realized.
examples.gm: Bodhisattvas entered into the supreme awakening of a Buddha Should rely on spiritual friends together with the perfections. Those who teach accordingly, this is the stage of accomplishment; By these two causes, they will swiftly realize the awakening of a Buddha.
examples.sa: बुद्धा य बोधिवरप्रस्थित बोधिसत्त्वा कल्याणमित्र इमि पारमिता निदिष्टाः । ते चानुशासक इयं प्रतिपत्तिभूमी दुवि कारणेन अनुबुध्यति बुद्धबोधिम् ॥

examples.dm: Bodhisattvas who have entered the supreme awakening of a Buddha Should rely on the perfections as their spiritual friends. Those who provide such instruction are the ground of accomplishment; Through these two causes, the awakening of a Buddha is swiftly realized.
examples.gm: Bodhisattvas entered into the supreme awakening of a Buddha Should rely on spiritual friends together with the perfections. Those who teach accordingly, this is the stage of accomplishment; By these two causes, they will swiftly realize the awakening of a Buddha.
examples.sa: बुद्धा य बोधिवरप्रस्थित बोधिसत्त्वा कल्याणमित्र इमि पारमिता निदिष्टाः । ते चानुशासक इयं प्रतिपत्तिभूमी दुवि कारणेन अनुबुध्यति बुद्धबोधिम् ॥

examples.dm: For all the Victors of the past, the future, and those residing in the ten directions, This perfection is the path; there is no other. This perfection is said to be the clarity, the lamp, the light, And the supreme guide for those who have entered upon supreme enlightenment.
examples.gm: The Victorious Ones of the past, future, and whoever abide in the ten directions, The path of all of them is this perfection, and no other. This perfection is, for those entered into supreme awakening, Explained as the supreme illumination, lamp, light, and teacher.
examples.sa: अतिक्रान्तनागत जिना स्थित ये दिशासु सर्वेषु मार्गु अयु पारमिता अनन्यो । ओभास उल्क वरबोधयि प्रस्थितानाम् आलोक शास्त्रि इमि पारमिता प्रदिष्टाः ॥

examples.dm: Sentient beings, completely famished, desire food, And those with minds attached to cyclic existence wander perpetually. The two phenomena of "self" and "mine" are unreal and empty; Yet the foolish, by their own doing, tie knots in the sky.
examples.gm: Fully starving sentient beings desire food, and Those possessing a mind attached to saṃsāra constantly wander. Both self and the phenomena of self are unreal and empty; Childish beings themselves have cast a knot in space.
examples.sa: आहारकाम परिकल्पयमान सत्त्वाः संसारि युक्तमनसः सद संस्मरन्ति । अहु मह्य धर्म उभि एति अभूत शून्या आकाशगण्ठि अयु आत्मन बद्ध बाले ॥

examples.dm: It is taught that the way one grasps is the way one is completely afflicted; It is said that when "I" and "mine" are not observed, there is total purification. In this, without anything being defiled or purified, The Bodhisattva realizes the perfection of wisdom.
examples.gm: Just as there is apprehension, so is complete affliction taught; Not apprehending self and what belongs to self is taught as complete purification; In this, without anything becoming afflicted or completely pure, The bodhisattva realizes the perfection of wisdom.
examples.sa: यथ उद्ग्रहो तथ प्रकाशितु संकिलेशो व्योदान उक्त अहु मह्य अनोपलब्धि । न हि अत्र कश्चि यो क्लिश्यति शुध्यते वा प्रज्ञाय पारमित बुध्यति बोधिसत्त्वे ॥

examples.dm: However many sentient beings there are throughout Jambudvīpa without exception, If all of them were to generate the mind of supreme enlightenment, And were to practice generosity for many tens of millions of millennia, And were to dedicate it all as a cause for awakening for the sake of all beings,
examples.gm: However many sentient beings there are in Jambudvīpa without exception, If all of them, having generated the mind toward supreme awakening, Were to give gifts for many tens of millions of thousands of years, And dedicate it all as a cause for awakening for the benefit of beings;
examples.sa: यावन्त सत्त्व निखिले इह जम्बुद्विपे ते सर्वि बोधिवरचित्त उपादयित्वा । दानं ददित्व बहुवर्षसहस्रकोटीः सर्वं च नामयि जगार्थनिदान बोधौ ॥

examples.dm: Yogis who practice the supreme perfection of wisdom, Though they generate great compassion, have no perception of sentient beings. At that time, those wise ones become the objects of offering for all the world; They always make meaningful use of the alms of the country.
examples.gm: The yogi practicing the supreme perfection of wisdom, Even when generating great compassion, has no perception of sentient beings; At that time, the wise one becomes a field of generosity for all beings, And always meaningfully fully enjoys the alms of the realm.
examples.sa: चरमाणु प्रज्ञवरपारमिताय योगी महतीं जनेति करुणां न च सत्त्वसंज्ञा । तद भोन्ति सर्वजगती विदु दक्षिणीया सततं अमोघु परिभुञ्जति राष्ट्रपिण्डम् ॥

examples.dm: Any bodhisattva who has long been connected to this, In order to liberate beings of the heavens, the human realm, and the three lower realms, And who desires to show the vast path to the realm of beings on the other side, Should day and night apply themselves to the perfection of wisdom.
examples.gm: Any bodhisattva who, for the sake of liberating The sentient beings of gods, humans, and the three lower realms bound here for a long time, Desires to teach the broad path to the other shore to the realm of beings, Should strive in the perfection of wisdom day and night.
examples.sa: चिरबुद्धदेवमनुजान् त्रिअपायि सत्त्वान् परिमोचितुं य इह इच्छति बोधिसत्त्वो । पृथुमार्गु तीरु उपदर्शयि सत्त्वधातौ प्रज्ञाय पारमित युक्त दिवा च रात्रौ ॥

examples.dm: Just as a person who finds a supreme jewel they had never found before, Is filled with joy at having found it at another time, If they become careless and lose it immediately after finding it, They will suffer constant longing for the jewel they have lost.
examples.gm: A person who previously had not found a supreme jewel, Finding it at another time, out of joy, If they lose it right after finding it by becoming careless, By losing it, desiring the jewel, they will constantly suffer.
examples.sa: पुरुषो य अग्रु रतनस्य अलब्धपूर्वो अपरस्मि कालि पुन लब्ध्व भवेय तुष्टो । स ह लब्ध्व नाशयि पुनोऽपि प्रमादभूतो नाशित्व दुःखि सततं रतनाभिकाङ्क्षी ॥

examples.dm: Likewise, the bodhisattva who practices the supreme perfection of wisdom, Dwelling in emptiness and the signless, Having destroyed the dense darkness of views, outshines all worldly beings, Arhats, Pratyekabuddhas, and the many bodhisattvas.
examples.gm: Just so, the bodhisattva practicing the supreme perfection of wisdom, Practicing emptiness and signlessness, The wise one, having destroyed the dense thicket of views, outshines all beings, Arhats, pratyekabuddhas, and many bodhisattvas.
examples.sa: एमेव प्रज्ञवरपारमितां चरन्तो विधमित्व दृष्टिगहनं विदु बोधिसत्त्वो । अभिभोन्ति सर्वजगती रहप्रत्ययांश्च शून्यानिमित्तचरितो पृथु बोधिसत्त्वो ॥

examples.dm: In this way, the bodhisattva who is skilled in the practice of wisdom Bestows the nectar of immortality and brings joy to gods and humans. If even now they strive for the benefit of many sentient beings, What need is there to mention when they are established as Kings of Dharma?
examples.gm: Likewise, the bodhisattva wise in practicing wisdom too, Gives the nectar and pleases gods and humans. Even as they are, they strive to benefit many sentient beings; What need is there to mention when they come to abide as the Dharma King!
examples.sa: एमेव प्रज्ञचरितो विदु बोधिसत्त्वो अमृतस्य दायकु प्रियो मरुमानुषाणाम् । अयु एष एषति हि सत्त्वसुखाभियुक्तो प्रागेव याव स्थितु भेष्यति धर्मराजो ॥

examples.gm: Likewise, the bodhisattva wise in practicing wisdom too, Gives the nectar and pleases gods and humans. Even as they are, they strive to benefit many sentient beings; What need is there to mention when they come to abide as the Dharma King!

examples.dm: However, when those wise ones possess intense resolve, And day and night look toward the supreme meaning of the perfection of wisdom, At that time, their body, mind, and speech move like a bird in the sky; How could the factions of darkness ever find an opportunity against them?
examples.gm: When those wise ones, possessing intense resolve, Behold the supreme meaning of the perfection of wisdom day and night, At that time, their body, mind, and speech move like a bird in the sky; How could the associates of the dark one find an opportunity?
examples.sa: यथ ते भवन्ति विदु आशयसंप्रयुक्ता दिवरात्रि प्रज्ञवरपारमितार्थदर्शी । तद कायचित्त खगपक्षिसतुल्यभूता अवतारु सो कुतु लभिष्यति कृष्णबन्धुः ॥

examples.dm: Both are distant and will become like flesh-eating demons; Both will cause their own commitments to degenerate. How can there be awakening for those who are hostile and devoid of patience? At that time, the Māras and their factions will be delighted.
examples.gm: "Those two will become distant, and they will become like flesh-eating demons; Both will cause their own promises to degenerate. How can there be awakening for those who are hostile and devoid of patience?" At that time, the Māras along with their factions will become joyful.
examples.sa: उभि एति दूरि भविष्यन्ति पिशाचतुल्या उभि एति आत्म करिष्यन्ति प्रतिज्ञहानिम् । दुष्टान क्षान्तिविकलान कुतोऽस्ति बोधि तद मारु तुष्टु भवती नमुचीसपक्षो ॥

examples.dm: The Buddhas reached awakening through the perfection of patience; Generating mindfulness, thinking, "This mind of mine is not good," One should individually confess and restrain it for the future, And not take delight in it; that is how one trains in this Dharma of the Buddha.
examples.gm: "Buddhas touch awakening through the perfection of patience." Generating mindfulness, thinking, "This mind is not good," Confessing individually and restraining themselves in the future, And not rejoicing, they train in this Dharma of the Buddhas.
examples.sa: अथ तस्युपद्यति मतीति अशोभना ति क्षान्तीय पारमित बोधि स्पृशन्ति बुद्धाः । प्रतिदर्शयाति पुन आयति संवराणि अपयाति वा स इह शिक्षति बुद्धधर्मे ॥

examples.dm: When training, one does not make any claims about the training; One does not perceive a trainee or the qualities to be trained in, And does not conceptualize between training and non-training— Whoever trains in this way trains here in these Buddha-qualities.
examples.gm: When training, whoever does not assert any training, And does not observe the trainer or the dharmas of training, And does not conceptualize these two: having trained and not having trained, Whoever trains like that, trains in this Dharma of the Buddhas.
examples.sa: यो शिक्षमाणु न उपैति कहिंचि शिक्षां न च शिक्षकं लभति नापि च शिक्षधर्मान् । शिक्षा अशिक्ष उभयो अविकल्पमानो यो शिक्षते स इह शिक्षति बुद्धधर्मे ॥

examples.dm: When training, one does not make any claims about the training; One does not perceive a trainee or the qualities to be trained in, And does not conceptualize between training and non-training— Whoever trains in this way trains here in these Buddha-qualities.
examples.gm: When training, whoever does not assert any training, And does not observe the trainer or the dharmas of training, And does not conceptualize these two: having trained and not having trained, Whoever trains like that, trains in this Dharma of the Buddhas.
examples.sa: यो शिक्षमाणु न उपैति कहिंचि शिक्षां न च शिक्षकं लभति नापि च शिक्षधर्मान् । शिक्षा अशिक्ष उभयो अविकल्पमानो यो शिक्षते स इह शिक्षति बुद्धधर्मे ॥

examples.dm: Any bodhisattva who understands this kind of training Will never again suffer a decline in training or become immoral; In order to please the Buddha-dharmas, they train in this, Skilled in the higher training, they train without apprehension.
examples.gm: Whichever bodhisattva knows this training like that, Will never become one with degenerate training or faulty ethical discipline; In order to please the Buddhas, they train in this; They are wise in the higher training and lack apprehension.
examples.sa: यो बोधिसत्त्व इमु जानति एव शिक्षां न स जातु शिक्षविकलो भवते दुशीलो । आराधितेषु इह शिक्षति बुद्धधर्मं शिक्षातिशिक्षकुशलो ति निरूपलम्भो ॥

examples.dm: In this way, the wise light-makers train in wisdom; They do not give rise to even a single unvirtuous thought. Just as darkness cannot remain in the space before it When it is overwhelmed by the rays of the sun moving through the sky,
examples.gm: The wise light-makers train in wisdom like that; They do not generate even a single non-virtuous mind. Just as, when outshone by the rays of the sun moving in the sky, Darkness does not remain in the space before it.
examples.sa: शिक्षन्तु एव विदु प्रज्ञ प्रभंकराणां नोत्पद्यते अकुशलमपि एकचित्तम् । सूर्ये यथा गगनि गच्छति अन्तरीक्षे रश्मीगते न स्थिहते पुरतोऽन्धकारम् ॥

examples.dm: For those who have trained in the perfection of wisdom, All the perfections are gathered within this. Just as the sixty-two views are contained within the view of the transitory collection, So too, it is taught that all these perfections are contained within this one.
examples.gm: For those who have trained in the perfection of wisdom, All perfections come to be included herein. Just as the sixty-two views are included within the view of the transitory collection, Likewise, these perfections are taught to be included (herein).
examples.sa: प्रज्ञाय पारमित शिक्षित संस्कृतानां सर्वेष पारमित भोन्तिह संगृहीताः । सत्कायदृष्टि यथ षष्टि दुवे च दृष्टी अन्तर्गतास्तथमि पारमिता भवन्ति ॥

examples.dm: For example, when the life faculty ceases, All other faculties, however many there may be, likewise cease. In the same way, for the supreme sages who practice the perfection of wisdom, It is taught that all the perfections are gathered within this.
examples.gm: For example, when the life faculty ceases, All the other faculties, however many there are, cease; Likewise, for the supreme wise ones practicing wisdom, All perfections are taught to be included herein.
examples.sa: यथ जीवितेन्द्रिय निरुद्धि य केचिदन्ये भोन्ती निरुद्ध पृथु इन्द्रिय यावदस्ति । एमेव प्रज्ञचरिते विदु उत्तमानां सर्वेत पारमित उक्त य संगृहीता ॥

examples.dm: Those who have entered into the supreme, irreversible awakening, Rejoice from the depths of their hearts in the generation of the mind of enlightenment; Though one might find the measure of the three thousandfold world system and Mount Meru by weighing them on a scale, The virtue of such rejoicing is not like that.
examples.gm: Regarding those who have fully entered supreme, irreversible awakening, Rejoicing from the depths of one's heart in their generation of the mind— The Mount Meru of a trichiliocosm could be measured by weighing it on a scale, But the virtue of that rejoicing is not like that.
examples.sa: अविवर्तियस्य वरबोधयि प्रस्थितस्य यो चित्तुपादु अनुमोदितु आशयेन । त्रिसहस्र मेरु तुलयित्व सियाप्रमाणो न त्वेव तस्य कुशलस्यनुमोदनाये ॥

examples.dm: Those who have entered into the supreme, irreversible awakening, Rejoice from the depths of their hearts in the generation of the mind of enlightenment; Though one might find the measure of the three thousandfold world system and Mount Meru by weighing them on a scale, The virtue of such rejoicing is not like that.

examples.dm: I also rejoice in the mass of merit of all sentient beings, as many as there are, Who strive for virtue and desire to be of benefit; Therefore, once they have attained the qualities of the Victors, They bestow the gift of Dharma upon the world in order to bring suffering to an end.
examples.gm: Seeking virtue and desiring to benefit however many sentient beings there are, They also rejoice in the heaps of merit of them all; Therefore, having attained the qualities of the Victorious Ones, In order to exhaust suffering, they give the gift of Dharma to the world.
examples.sa: यावन्त सत्त्व कुशलार्थिक मोक्षकामा सर्वेष भोन्ति अनुमोदितु पुण्यराशि । सत्त्वर्थि ते जिनगुण अनन्त प्रापुणित्वा दास्यन्ति धर्म जगती दुखसंक्षयाये ॥

examples.dm: Any bodhisattva who fully understands that all phenomena are non-conceptual, Empty, signless, and free from conceptual proliferation, Does not seek awakening through a dualistic wisdom; That yogi strives in the supreme perfection of wisdom.
examples.gm: Whichever bodhisattva, non-conceptualizing, fully knows all dharmas As empty, signless, and free from elaboration, They do not seek awakening through dualistic wisdom; That yogin exerts themselves in the supreme perfection of wisdom.
examples.sa: यो बोधिसत्त्व अविकल्पकु सर्वधर्मान् शून्यानिमित्त परिजानति निष्प्रपञ्चान् । न च प्रज्ञ बोधि परिएषति आशयेन सो युक्त प्रज्ञवरपारमिताय योगी ॥

examples.dm: Just as the element of space and that space itself do not conflict, And it does not exist as something to be attained by anyone at all, Likewise, the bodhisattva who is skilled in the practice of wisdom Is like space, and practices in a state of total peace.
examples.gm: That realm of space and what contradicts that space Do not exist, and no one has attained them; Likewise, the wise bodhisattvas practicing wisdom Are like space and practice total peace.
examples.sa: आकाशधातु गगनस्य सिया विरोधो न हि तेन तस्य कुतु केनचिदेष प्राप्ता । एमेव प्रज्ञचरितो विदु बोधिसत्त्वो अभ्योवकाशसदृशो उपशान्तचारी ॥

examples.dm: In the midst of a crowd, a conjured person does not think, "I must please these people," and yet they perform that very action; Although they are seen displaying various miraculous feats, They possess no body, no mind, and not even a name.
examples.gm: In the midst of people, an illusory person does not think, "I will please these people," yet still pleases them; Though seen to display various miracles, They have no body, no mind, and not even a name.
examples.sa: यथ मायकारपुरुषस्य न एव भोति ते शिष्य मां जनत सो च करोति कार्यम् । पश्यन्ति तं विविध कार्यु निदर्शयन्तं न च तस्य कायु न पि चित्त न नामधेयम् ॥

examples.dm: For example, a phantom buddha performs the deeds of a buddha, Yet not even a trace of pride arises in that performance. Likewise, the bodhisattva who is skilled in the practice of wisdom Displays all activities just like a magical emanation.
examples.gm: For example, an emanation of a Buddha performs the deeds of a Buddha, And in doing so, not even a little pride arises; Likewise, the wise bodhisattvas practicing wisdom Demonstrate all activities like an emanation or an illusion.
examples.sa: यथ बुद्ध निर्मित करोति च बुद्धकार्यं न च तस्युपद्यति मदो करमाणु किंचित् । एमेव प्रज्ञचरितो विदु बोधिसत्त्वो दर्शेति सर्व क्रिय निर्मितमायतुल्यम् ॥

examples.dm: Just as a skilled carpenter creates mechanical figures of men and women That perform all kinds of tasks, Likewise, the bodhisattva who is skilled in the practice of wisdom Performs all activities through non-conceptual primordial awareness.
examples.gm: A wise carpenter crafts figures similar to Men and women, and they also perform all activities; Likewise, the wise bodhisattvas practicing wisdom Perform all activities with non-conceptualizing pristine awareness.
examples.sa: पलगण्ड दक्ष विदुना कृतु दारुयन्त्रो पुरुषे स्त्रितुल्य स करोति ह सर्वकार्यम् । एमेव प्रज्ञचरितो विदु बोधिसत्त्वो ज्ञानेन सर्व क्रिय कुर्वति निर्विकल्पो ॥

examples.dm: To those who practice skillfully in this way, the many hosts of gods Join their palms in reverence and prostrate. All the Buddhas throughout the world systems of the ten directions Likewise utter garlands of praise for their qualities.
examples.gm: To the wise who practice thus, many hosts of gods Join their palms, bow down, and pay homage; And however many Buddhas there are in the world systems of the ten directions, They completely proclaim a garland of praise for their qualities.
examples.sa: एवं चरन्तु विदु ना पृथुदेवसंघाः कृतअञ्जलीपुट प्रणम्य नमस्ययन्ति । बुद्धा पि यावत दशद्दिशि लोकधातौ गुणवर्णमालपरिकीर्तन कुर्वयन्ति ॥

examples.dm: Through four causes, the wise and powerful bodhisattva Is difficult for the four Māras to overcome and cannot be shaken: Abiding in emptiness, never forsaking sentient beings, Acting exactly as one speaks, and possessing the blessings of the Sugatas.
examples.gm: By four causes, the wise bodhisattva possesses strength, Is hard to overcome by the four Māras, and cannot be moved: Dwelling in emptiness, not forsaking sentient beings, Acting as they have spoken, and possessing the blessing of the Sugatas.
examples.sa: चतुकारणेहि बलवां विदु बोधिसत्त्वो भवते दुघर्षु चतुमारअसंप्रकम्प्यो । शून्याविहारि भवते न च सत्त्वत्यागी यथवादि सत्त्वकरुणानुगतावस्थानः ॥

examples.gm: By four causes, the wise bodhisattva possesses strength, Is hard to overcome by the four Māras, and cannot be moved: Dwelling in emptiness, not forsaking sentient beings, Acting as they have spoken, and possessing the blessing of the Sugatas.
examples.sa: चतुकारणेहि बलवां विदु बोधिसत्त्वो भवते दुघर्षु चतुमारअसंप्रकम्प्यो । शून्याविहारि भवते न च सत्त्वत्यागी यथवादि सत्त्वकरुणानुगतावस्थानः ॥

examples.dm: When this perfection of wisdom, the Mother of the Tathāgatas, is taught, Any bodhisattva who feels devotion and, with sincere resolve, Applies themselves with effort to its realization, Should be known as one who has entered into omniscience itself.
examples.gm: This perfection of wisdom, the mother of the Tathāgatas, When it is taught, whichever bodhisattva aspires to it, And clearly exerts themselves to accomplish it with sincere intent, That noble one should be known to have entered into omniscience.
examples.sa: यो बोधिसत्त्व अधिमुच्यति भाष्यमाणाम् इम प्रज्ञपारमित मात तथागतानाम् । प्रतिपत्तिया च अभियुज्यति आशयेन सर्वज्ञताय अभिप्रस्थितु वेदितव्यो ॥

examples.dm: It does not abide within the dharmadhātu or suchness; For example, like a cloud in the sky, it abides without a place to abide. A mantra-holder, a sky-traveler without a fixed abode, desiring a place to stay, Through the power of mantra, blesses trees to be endowed with out-of-season flowers.
examples.gm: They do not dwell in the dharmadhātu or suchness, For example, like clouds in space, they dwell without dwelling. A mantra-holder, without a dwelling, moving in space, wishing to dwell, By the power of mantras, is endowed with out-of-season flowers and blesses them.
examples.sa: न च धर्मधातुतथताय उपैति स्थानं भवती अथानस्थित सो लघु अन्तरीक्षे । विद्याधरो व अभिलम्भु वनाभिप्राया खगु कालहीन द्रुम मन्त्रबलाधिष्ठानो ॥

examples.dm: Though birds dwell in the sky, they do not fall; Though fish dwell in the water, they do not suffocate or die. Likewise, through the power of meditative concentration, Bodhisattvas Who have reached the far shore dwell in emptiness but do not pass into nirvāṇa.
examples.gm: A bird dwells in the sky, yet does not fall; A fish dwells in water, yet does not suffocate and die; Likewise, the bodhisattva, by the powers of concentration, Having reached the other shore, dwells in emptiness and does not pass into nirvāṇa.
examples.sa: आकाशि पक्षि विहराति न चो पताति दकमध्यि मत्स्य विहराति न चो मराति । एमेव ध्यानबलपारगु बोधिसत्त्वो शून्याविहारि न च निर्वृति प्रापुणाति ॥

examples.dm: Those who wish to attain the supreme qualities of all beings, To touch the most marvelous and supreme primordial wisdom of the Buddha, And to bestow the most excellent and holy gift of Dharma, Should rely upon this supreme state of the benefactors.
examples.gm: To go to the supreme qualities of all sentient beings, And to touch the supremely marvelous, supreme Buddha-wisdom, Whosoever desires to give the supreme, holy gift of Dharma, Rely on this supreme dwelling of those who bring benefit!
examples.sa: यो सर्वसत्त्वगुण-अग्रतु गन्तुकामो अग्रं स्पृशेय परमाद्भुत बुद्धज्ञानम् । अग्रं ददेय वर उत्तमधर्मदानम् इमु अग्रु सेवतु विहारु हितंकराणाम् ॥

examples.dm: This is the supreme treasure of Dharma and the most excellent Dharma treasury; It is the Buddha lineage, the treasury of happiness and joy for all beings. The protectors of the world in the ten directions—those of the past and those yet to come— All arise from this, yet the expanse of reality is never exhausted.
examples.gm: This is the supreme Dharma-treasure and the holy Dharma-treasury; It is the lineage of the Buddhas, the treasury of happiness and joy of beings. The protectors of the world of the past, future, and the ten directions, Though they are born from this, the dharmadhātu does not become exhausted.
examples.sa: अग्रं निधान अयु उत्तमधर्मकोश बुद्धान गोत्रजननं सुखसौख्यगञ्जो । अतिक्रान्तनागत दशद्दिशि लोकनाथा इतु ते प्रसूत न च क्षीयति धर्मधातुः ॥

examples.dm: However many aspects of primordial wisdom, gateways, methods, and roots there may be, All these arise from the supreme Perfection of Wisdom. When conditions assemble, the machine of karma fully emerges; In the Perfection of Wisdom, there is no exhaustion and no increase.
examples.gm: However many approaches to knowledge, methods, and roots there are, They all arise from the supreme perfection of wisdom; When conditions come together, the machine of activities perfectly arises, Yet the perfection of wisdom has no exhaustion and no increase.
examples.sa: यावन्ति ज्ञान नयद्वार उयायमूलाः सर्वे ति प्रज्ञवरपारमिताप्रसूताः । सामग्रिप्रत्यय प्रवर्तति ज्ञानयन्त्रो न च प्रज्ञपारमित वर्धति हीयते वा ॥

examples.dm: Any bodhisattva who, regarding dependent origination, Understands this wisdom to be without birth and without exhaustion, Just as the cloudless sun dispels darkness by radiating its beams of light, Will, by destroying the dense gloom of ignorance, attain the self-arisen state.
examples.gm: Whichever bodhisattva, with regard to dependent origination, Knows this wisdom as unborn and unexhausted, Just as the cloudless sun dispels darkness by emitting rays of light, Having destroyed dense ignorance, will attain the state of the Self-Arisen.
examples.sa: यो तु प्रतीत्यसमुत्पादु अनुद्भवाये इमु प्रज्ञ अक्षयत बुध्यति बोधिसत्त्वो । सो सूर्य अभ्रपटले यथ मुक्तरश्मी विधमित्वविद्यपटलं भवते स्वयंभूः ॥

examples.gm: Whichever bodhisattva, with regard to dependent origination, Knows this wisdom as unborn and unexhausted, Just as the cloudless sun dispels darkness by emitting rays of light, Having destroyed dense ignorance, will attain the state of the Self-Arisen.

examples.dm: Possessing great power, they also dwell in the four concentrations, Yet they do not rely upon them, nor do they make them a fixed abode. Nevertheless, these four concentrations, along with their respective branches, Serve as the basis for attaining the supreme and most excellent awakening.
examples.gm: Endowed with great power, they even abide in the four dhyānas; They do not rely on them and do not abide in them; Nevertheless, these four dhyānas along with their branches, Become the support for attaining supreme holy awakening.
examples.sa: चतुर्भी च ध्यान विहरन्ति महानुभावा न च आलयो न पि च निश्रयु कुर्वयाति । अपि खो पुनाश्रयु इमे चतुध्यान साङ्गा भेष्यन्ति बोधिवर-उत्तमप्रापणाय ॥

examples.dm: Those who have attained supreme wisdom and abide in the meditative concentrations Also experience the four sublime formless meditative stabilizations. These concentrations are beneficial for supreme and sublime awakening; Yet, a bodhisattva does not train in them for the sake of exhausting the outflows.
examples.gm: Those who have attained supreme wisdom and abide in the dhyānas, Also experience the four holy formless samādhis; These dhyānas are beneficial for supreme holy awakening, But the bodhisattva does not train to exhaust the defilements.
examples.sa: ध्याने स्थितोऽत्र भवती वरप्रज्ञलाभी आरूप्यरूपि च समाधि चतस्र श्रेष्ठा । उपकारिभूत इमि ध्यान वराग्रबोधौ न पुनास्रवक्षति स शिक्षति बोधिसत्त्वो ॥

These concentrations are beneficial for supreme and sublime awakening; Yet, a bodhisattva does not train in them for the sake of exhausting the outflows.

examples.dm: This is a marvelous and wondrous accumulation of qualities: Abiding in meditative concentration and stabilization, they are without signs. If those who abide therein should have their bodies perish, They will be reborn in the desire realm exactly according to their intentions.
examples.gm: This is the marvelous wonder of accumulating qualities: Having abided in the samādhis of the dhyānas, they have no signs; If the bodies of those who abide in them were to fall apart, They are again born in the desire realm according to their intention.
examples.sa: आश्चर्यम् अद्भुतम् इदं गुणसंचयानां ध्याने समाधि विहरन्ति निमित्त नास्ति । तत्र स्थितान यदि भज्यति आत्मभावो पुन कामधातु उपपद्यति यथाभिप्राया ॥

examples.dm: For example, it is like a person of Jambudvīpa who had never before Reached the supreme city of the gods, but later goes there; Having seen those lands that are fully possessed there, Just as one who returns here does not become attached,
examples.gm: For example, if a man of Jambudvīpa who previously Had not gone to the supreme city of the gods of the divine realm were to go later, Having seen those completely possessed objects, When he returns here, he does not become attached to them;
examples.sa: यथ जम्बुद्वीपक मनुष्य अलब्धपूर्वा दिवि देवौत्तमपुरा अनुप्रापुणेया । पश्यित्व ते विषय तत्र परिगृहीता पुनरागमेय न च निश्रयु तत्र कुर्यात् ॥

examples.dm: Likewise, the bodhisattvas who possess supreme qualities, Diligent in yoga and abiding in meditative concentration and absorption, Dwell once again in the desire realm without attachment; Like a lotus in the water, they are not stained by the qualities of the foolish.
examples.gm: Similarly, those who hold the supreme qualities of a bodhisattva, Exerting themselves in yoga and abiding in the samādhis of the dhyānas, Again abide in the desire realm without attachment; Like a lotus in water, they do not abide in the dharmas of fools.
examples.sa: एमेव ते गुणधरा वरबोधिसत्त्वा ध्याने समाधि विहरित्व प्रयुक्तयोगी । पुन कामधातुस्थित भोन्ति अनोपलिप्ता पद्मेव वारिणि अनिश्रित बालधर्मे ॥

examples.dm: The great beings exist solely to bring sentient beings to maturity, To purify the fields, and to complete the perfections; They do not seek rebirth in the formless realm, thinking That the qualities of enlightenment and the perfections would thereby decline.
examples.gm: The great beings, to completely ripen sentient beings, Act only to purify the realms and complete the perfections; Thinking, "The qualities of awakening and the perfections will diminish," They do not seek birth in the formless realm.
examples.sa: अन्यत्र सत्त्वपरिपाचन क्षेत्रशोधी परिपूरणार्थ इमि पारमिता महात्मा । आरूप्यधातुउपपत्ति न प्रार्थयन्ती यत्रेह बोधिगुणपारमितान हानि ॥

examples.dm: Likewise, the wise bodhisattva, having attained the fourfold tranquility Of concentration and meditative absorption that bestows joy and bliss, Relinquishes that blissful concentration and the meditative absorptions they have attained, And out of compassion for beings, enters again into the realm of desire.
examples.gm: Similarly, the wise bodhisattva, joy and Having attained the happiness-bestowing four peaceful samādhis of the dhyānas, Lets go of the attainment of the dhyāna samādhis endowed with the bliss of the dhyānas, And endowed with compassion for beings, again enters the desire realm.
examples.sa: एमेव ध्यान चतुर् एव समाधि शान्तां लब्ध्वान प्रीति सुखदां विदु बोधिसत्त्वाः । अवसृज्य ध्यानसुखप्रीतिसमाधिलाभं पुन कामधातु प्रविशन्ति जगानुकम्पी ॥

examples.dm: Likewise, the wise bodhisattva, having attained the fourfold tranquility Of concentration and meditative absorption that bestows joy and bliss, Relinquishes that blissful concentration and the meditative absorptions they have attained, And out of compassion for beings, enters again into the realm of desire.
examples.gm: Similarly, the wise bodhisattva, joy and Having attained the happiness-bestowing four peaceful samādhis of the dhyānas, Lets go of the attainment of the dhyāna samādhis endowed with the bliss of the dhyānas, And endowed with compassion for beings, again enters the desire realm.

examples.dm: If a bodhisattva, while dwelling in meditative absorption and concentration, Should generate a mind that desires the vehicle of the Arhats or Pratyekabuddhas, They have become uncomposed, agitated, and mentally distracted; The Buddha's qualities are completely lost, like a ferryman whose boat has been wrecked.
examples.gm: If a bodhisattva abides in the samādhis of the dhyānas, But generates a mind desiring the vehicle of an arhat or pratyekabuddha, They are not in meditative equipoise, but agitated and their mind is distracted; The qualities of a Buddha completely diminish, like a boatman whose boat breaks.
examples.sa: यदि बोधिसत्त्व विहराति समाधिध्याने रहप्रत्ययानि स्पृहबुद्धि न संजनेय्या । असमाहितो भवति उद्धतक्षिप्तचित्तो परिहीनबुद्धिगुण नाविक भिन्ननावो ॥

examples.gm: If a bodhisattva abides in the samādhis of the dhyānas, But generates a mind desiring the vehicle of an arhat or pratyekabuddha, They are not in meditative equipoise, but agitated and their mind is distracted; The qualities of a Buddha completely diminish, like a boatman whose boat breaks.
examples.sa: यदि बोधिसत्त्व विहराति समाधिध्याने रहप्रत्ययानि स्पृहबुद्धि न संजनेय्या । असमाहितो भवति उद्धतक्षिप्तचित्तो परिहीनबुद्धिगुण नाविक भिन्ननावो ॥

examples.dm: Furthermore, even though they are intensely engaged with the five sensory qualities— Forms, sounds, smells, tastes, and textures— If they take joy in the Bodhicitta that is free from the vehicles of the Arhats and Pratyekabuddhas, Know that these heroes are always in meditative equipoise.
examples.gm: Moreover, forms and sounds, and likewise smells and tastes, Touches, and the five qualities of desire, even if they exert themselves in these, If they are free from the vehicles of the arhat and pratyekabuddha and delight in the mind of awakening, The hero should be known to be constantly in meditative equipoise.
examples.sa: किंचापि रूपम् अपि शब्द तथैव गन्धो रस स्पर्श कामगुण पञ्चभि युक्त भोगी । रहप्रत्ययान विगतोऽनन्तबोधिसत्त्वो सततं समाहितु प्रजानयितव्य शूरो ॥

examples.dm: For the sake of other beings and persons, the bodhisattva of pure intention Applies themselves with diligent exertion to the perfection of perseverance. For example, just as a female slave carrying water is powerless and under the control of her master, So too do the heroic beings proceed under the control of all sentient beings.
examples.gm: For the sake of other sentient beings and persons, the perfectly pure bodhisattva Manifestly exerts themselves and acts in the perfection of diligence; For example, a servant woman drawing water has no power of her own, but is under the power of her master; Similarly, the heroes act under the power of all sentient beings.
examples.sa: परसत्त्वपुद्गलनिदान विशुद्धसत्त्वा विचरन्ति वीर्यबलपारमिताभियुक्ताः । यथ कुम्भदासि अवशावश भर्तिकस्य तथ सर्वसत्त्ववशतामुपयान्ति धीराः ॥

examples.dm: Any bodhisattva who wishes to remain for a long time in cyclic existence, A yogi who perseveres in the welfare of sentient beings and the purification of the realm, If they do not give rise to even a speck of weariness, They possess the perfection of diligence and are never negligent.
examples.gm: Whatever bodhisattva wishes to cycle in saṃsāra for a long time, A yogi exerting themselves for the benefit of sentient beings and purifying the realms, If they do not generate even an atom of a weary mind, They are endowed with the perfection of diligence and are free from idleness.
examples.sa: यो बोधिसत्त्व चिरसंसरणाभिप्रायो सत्त्वार्थ क्षेत्रपरिशोधनयुक्तयोगी । न च खेदबुद्धि अणुमात्र उपादियाति सो वीर्यपारमितयुक्त अतन्द्रितश् च ॥

examples.dm: If unskilled bodhisattvas count out tens of millions of eons, And, perceiving it as a long time, strive for enlightenment with a sense of hardship, They will suffer for a long duration while practicing the authentic Dharma. Such individuals are lazy, and their perfection of diligence declines.
examples.gm: The unwise bodhisattva counts tens of millions of eons; If they perceive them as long, they suffer in accomplishing awakening; When accomplishing the authentic dharma, they suffer for a long time; Their perfection of diligence diminishes and they possess laziness.
examples.sa: सचि कल्पकोटि गणये विदु बोधिसत्त्वो चिरसंज्ञ बोधि समुदानिय तेन दुःखे । चिरदुःख भेष्यति समाचरमाणु धर्मं ततु वीर्यपारमितहीन कुसीदरूपो ॥

examples.dm: From the first generation of the mind set upon supreme enlightenment, Until the attainment of unsurpassed awakening, If one maintains this mental focus for even a single day and night, The wise and clear-minded should be known as having initiated diligence.
examples.gm: From the first generation of the mind for supreme awakening, Up until unsurpassable awakening is attained, If they consider it in their mind as just a single day and night, The radiant wise one should be known as having commenced diligence.
examples.sa: प्रथमं उपादु वरबोधयि चित्तुपादो सो वा अनुत्तरशिवाम् अनुप्रापुणेया । रात्रिंदिवैकमनसा तम् अधिष्ठिहेया आरम्भवीर्य विदु पण्डितु वेदितव्यो ॥

examples.dm: If, with the thought, "I shall bring all beings to maturity and act for their benefit," One applies oneself with body, speech, and mind, Yet remains dwelling in the perception of a self, one has become lazy; They are as far from omniscience as the earth is from the sky.
examples.gm: Thinking, "Having completely ripened beings, I will act for their benefit," If they exert themselves with body, speech, and mind, Because they abide in the perception of a self, they have become lazy, And they become as far from omniscience as the sky is from the earth.
examples.sa: सचि कायचित्तवचसा च पराक्रमेय्या परिपाचयित्व जगती करिष्यामि अर्थम् । कौसीद्यप्राप्त भवती स्थितु आत्मसंज्ञैः नैरात्मभावनविदूरि नभं व भूमेः ॥

examples.dm: When they have no perception of a body, a mind, or a sentient being, And having turned back from perceptions, they practice the non-dual Dharma— This is what the Benefactor called the perfection of perseverance For those who desire the supreme, undeterred, and peaceful awakening.
examples.gm: Whenever there is no perception of body, mind, and sentient beings, And having completely turned away from perception, one practices the non-dual dharma, For one who desires the supreme, unwaning, peaceful awakening, This was taught by the Benefactor to be the perfection of diligence.
examples.sa: यस्मिन् न कायु न पि चित्त न सत्त्वसंज्ञा संज्ञाविवर्ति स्थितु अद्वयधर्मचारी । अयु वीर्यपारमित उक्त हितंकरेण आकाङ्क्षमाणु शिवम् अच्युतम् अग्रबोधिम् ॥

examples.dm: If they should hear others speaking ill or using harsh words, The wise bodhisattva rejoices, thinking, "This is my happiness." Who speaks, who hears, who [speaks] to whom, and for what reason? One who possesses this supreme perfection of patience is wise.
examples.gm: If one hears abusive and harsh words from others, Thinking, "I am happy," the wise bodhisattva rejoices; Who speaks, who hears, by what, what is it, and for what reason? The wise one is endowed with the supreme perfection of patience.
examples.sa: परुषं श्रुणित्व वचनं परतो दुरुक्तं परितोषयाति सुसुखं विदु बोधिसत्त्वो । को भाषते क शृणुते कुतु कस्य केन सो युक्त क्षान्तिवरपारमिताय विज्ञो ॥

examples.dm: Any bodhisattva who possesses the excellent quality of patience— Suppose someone were to fill the three thousandfold world system with jewels and offer them to the Knower of the World, To the Buddhas, Arhats, and Pratyekabuddhas; The mass of merit from that giving would not equal even a fraction of this.
examples.gm: Whatever bodhisattva is endowed with the excellent dharma of patience, Compared to someone who fills the three thousandfold world system with jewels and offers them to the Knowers of the World, The Buddhas, arhats, and solitary realizers, That mass of generosity cannot match a fraction of the merit of the former.
examples.sa: सो बोधिसत्त्व क्षमते गुणधर्मयुक्तो यश् चैव रत्नभरितं त्रिसहस्र दद्यात् । बुद्धान लोकविदुनार्हतप्रत्ययानां कलपुण्य सो न भवते इह दानस्कन्धे ॥

examples.dm: The body of one who abides in patience becomes completely pure, Possessing the thirty-two major marks and infinite power; They proclaim the supreme Dharma of emptiness to sentient beings. Wise and patient, they bring joy to the world.
examples.gm: The body of one who abides in patience becomes completely pure; With the thirty-two marks and boundless power and strength, They proclaim the supreme empty dharma to sentient beings; Beings will rejoice in this wise one endowed with patience.
examples.sa: क्षान्तीस्थितस्य परिशुध्यति आत्मभावो द्वात्रिंशलक्षणप्रभाव अनन्तपारो । सत्त्वान शून्यवरधर्म निशामयाती प्रियु भोति सर्वजगती क्षममाणु विज्ञो ॥

examples.dm: The body of one who abides in patience becomes completely pure, Possessing the thirty-two major marks and infinite power; They proclaim the supreme Dharma of emptiness to sentient beings. Wise and patient, they bring joy to the world.
examples.gm: The body of one who abides in patience becomes completely pure; With the thirty-two marks and boundless power and strength, They proclaim the supreme empty dharma to sentient beings; Beings will rejoice in this wise one endowed with patience.
examples.sa: क्षान्तीस्थितस्य परिशुध्यति आत्मभावो द्वात्रिंशलक्षणप्रभाव अनन्तपारो । सत्त्वान शून्यवरधर्म निशामयाती प्रियु भोति सर्वजगती क्षममाणु विज्ञो ॥

examples.dm: If some being were to take a sachet of sandalwood powder And, with great devotion, apply it to a bodhisattva, While another person sprinkles glowing embers over his head, He should generate a mind that is equal and impartial toward both.
examples.gm: If some sentient being takes a handful of sandalwood And with great respect rubs it on the bodhisattva, While another scatters burning coals on their head, towards both They should generate an equal and even mind.
examples.sa: सचि कश्चि चन्दनपुटं ग्रहियान सत्त्वो अभ्योकिरेय गुरुप्रेमत बोधिसत्त्वम् । द्वितीयोऽपि अग्नि सकले शिरसि क्षिपेया उभयत्र तुल्यु मनु तेन उपादितव्यो ॥

examples.dm: One who practices patience should also cultivate this thought: "In the hells, the animal realm, and the world of Yama, there is much suffering. Since I have helplessly experienced harm due to the causes of sensual desire, Why should I not now endure hardship for the sake of enlightenment?"
examples.gm: The one who practices patience should also generate the mind thinking this: "In the hells, animal realms, and the world of Yama, there is much suffering; If one experiences unavoidable harm as a result of sensory pleasures, Why should I not now practice patience for the sake of awakening?"
examples.sa: क्षममाणु एव पुन चित्त उपादितव्यो नरकेषु तिर्ययमलोकि अनेक दुःखा । अनुभूय कामगुणहेतु अकामकारा कस्मा हु अद्य न क्षमेय निदान बोधौ ॥

examples.dm: One who practices patience should also cultivate this thought: "In the hells, the animal realm, and the world of Yama, there is much suffering. Since I have helplessly experienced harm due to the causes of sensual desire, Why should I not now endure hardship for the sake of enlightenment?"
examples.gm: The one who practices patience should also generate the mind thinking this: "In the hells, animal realms, and the world of Yama, there is much suffering; If one experiences unavoidable harm as a result of sensory pleasures, Why should I not now practice patience for the sake of awakening?"
examples.sa: क्षममाणु एव पुन चित्त उपादितव्यो नरकेषु तिर्ययमलोकि अनेक दुःखा । अनुभूय कामगुणहेतु अकामकारा कस्मा हु अद्य न क्षमेय निदान बोधौ ॥

examples.dm: Even if a bodhisattva indulges in the five objects of sensory desire, If they have gone for refuge to the Buddha, the Dharma, and the noble Sangha, And maintain the mental orientation toward omniscience, thinking, "I must achieve buddhahood," The wise should understand that they abide in the perfection of ethical discipline.
examples.gm: Even if a bodhisattva enjoys the five sensory pleasures, If they have taken refuge in the Buddha, Dharma, and the noble Sangha, And direct their mind toward omniscience, thinking, "I will accomplish buddhahood!" The wise one should be known as abiding in the perfection of discipline.
examples.sa: यदि पञ्च कामगुण भुञ्जति बोधिसत्त्वो बुद्धं च धर्म शरणागतु आर्यसंघम् । सर्वज्ञता च मनसी भविष्यामि बुद्धो स्थितु शीलपारमित वेदयितव्य विज्ञो ॥

examples.dm: If, for ten million eons, one practices the ten paths of virtuous action, Yet generates a desire for the state of an Arhat or a Pratyekabuddha, At that moment, one’s ethical discipline is flawed and has degenerated; That generation of such a thought is far weightier than even a formal defeat.
examples.gm: Even if one practices the ten paths of virtuous action for ten million aeons, If one generates the desire for the state of an arhat or solitary realizer, At that time, one's discipline becomes flawed and one's discipline degenerates; Generating that mind is much heavier even than a defeat.
examples.sa: यदि कल्पकोटि दशभी कुशलैः पथेभिश् चरमाणु प्रत्ययरहत्वस्पृहां जनेति । तद खण्डशीलु भवते अपि छिद्रशीलो पाराजिको गुरुतरो अयु चित्तुपादो ॥

examples.dm: If, for ten million eons, one practices the ten paths of virtuous action, Yet generates a desire for the state of an Arhat or a Pratyekabuddha, At that moment, one’s ethical discipline is flawed and has degenerated; That generation of such a thought is far weightier than even a formal defeat.

examples.sa: यदि कल्पकोटि दशभी कुशलैः पथेभिश् चरमाणु प्रत्ययरहत्वस्पृहां जनेति । तद खण्डशीलु भवते अपि छिद्रशीलो पाराजिको गुरुतरो अयु चित्तुपादो ॥

examples.dm: While guarding ethical discipline and fully dedicating it to supreme awakening, One is without conceit and does not praise oneself; One has completely abandoned the perception of a self and the perception of sentient beings; Such a bodhisattva is said to abide in the perfection of ethical discipline.
examples.gm: Guarding discipline and completely dedicating it to supreme awakening, Without conceit about it and without praising oneself, Completely abandoning the perception of "I" and the perception of sentient beings— Such a bodhisattva is said to abide in the perfection of discipline.
examples.sa: रक्षन्तु शील परिणामयि अग्रबोधिं न च तेन मन्यति न आत्मन कर्षयेथा । अहुसंज्ञता च परिवर्जित सत्त्वसंज्ञा स्थितु शीलपारमिति वुच्यति बोधिसत्त्वो ॥

examples.dm: If a bodhisattva practicing the path of the Victors thinks, "These sentient beings are ethical, but those are unethical," Engaging in such diverse perceptions, they are utterly lacking in ethical discipline; Their morality has degenerated, and they lack completely purified morality.
examples.gm: If a bodhisattva practicing the path of the Victorious Ones Thinks, "These sentient beings have discipline; these have broken discipline," By engaging in such diverse perceptions, their discipline is completely broken; Their discipline degenerates, and they lack completely pure discipline.
examples.sa: यदि बोधिसत्त्व चरमाणु जिनान मार्गे इमि शीलवानिमि दुशील करोति सत्त्वान् । नानात्वसंज्ञप्रसृतो परमं दुशीलो अपि छिद्रशीलु न तु सो परिशुद्धशीलो ॥

examples.dm: If a bodhisattva practicing the path of the Victors thinks, "These sentient beings are ethical, but those are unethical," Engaging in such diverse perceptions, they are utterly lacking in ethical discipline; Their morality has degenerated, and they lack completely purified morality.
examples.gm: If a bodhisattva practicing the path of the Victorious Ones Thinks, "These sentient beings have discipline; these have broken discipline," By engaging in such diverse perceptions, their discipline is completely broken; Their discipline degenerates, and they lack completely pure discipline.

examples.dm: For one who has no perception of a self or perception of a sentient being, And whose perceptions are free from attachment, how could there be a lack of restraint? One who has no conceit regarding restraint or lack of restraint— This is what the Guide has called the restraint of morality.
examples.gm: Whoever has no perception of self and no perception of sentient beings, Being free from attachment to perceptions, how could they have non-restraint? Whoever has no conceit regarding restraint and non-restraint, This was taught by the Guide to be the discipline of restraint.
examples.sa: यस्यो न अस्ति अहसंज्ञ न सत्त्वसंज्ञा संज्ञाविरागु कुतु तस्य असंवरोऽस्ति । यस्यो न संवरि असंवरि मन्यनास्ति अयु शीलसंवरु प्रकाशितु नायकेन ॥

examples.dm: Any pure being who possesses such morality as this, Is without bias toward anything pleasant or unpleasant. They give away their heads, hands, and feet without a trace of discouragement; They give away all their possessions, remaining forever free from attachment.
examples.gm: Any pure sentient being who thus possesses discipline Has no view of anything as pleasant or unpleasant. Giving away their head, hands, and feet, they have no shrinking mind; Giving away all their possessions, they are always free from clinging.
examples.sa: यो एवशीलसमन्वागतु निष्प्रपञ्चो अनपेक्षको भवति सर्वप्रियाप्रियेषु । शिरहस्तपाद त्यजमान अदीनचित्तो सर्वास्तित्यागि भवते सततं अलीनो ॥

examples.dm: Having realized that all phenomena are by nature selfless and insubstantial, If they can give away even their own flesh without a discouraged mind, Then at that time, what need is there to mention the giving of external objects? If they were to be stingy, it would be impossible.
examples.gm: Knowing that all dharmas are by nature selfless and insubstantial, If they give away even their own flesh without a shrinking mind, Then what need is there to mention giving away external objects? For them to act with miserliness is impossible.
examples.sa: ज्ञात्वा च धर्मप्रकृतीं वशिका निरात्म्यं आत्मान मांस त्यजमानु अदीनचित्तो । प्रागेव वस्तु तद बाहिर नात्यजेया अस्थानमेत यदि मत्सरि सो करेया ॥

examples.dm: Those who grasp at the actual perception of a self and hold things as "mine" are attached; How could fools like these ever have the intention to give? Those who are stingy will be born in the realm of hungry ghosts; Even if they are born as humans, they will be destitute at that time.
examples.gm: Perceiving a self, one is attached to things through grasping them as "mine"; How could fools have the mind of generosity? Miserly ones will be born in the realm of hungry ghosts; Or even if they are born as humans, they will then be impoverished.
examples.sa: अहसंज्ञतस्तु ममता भवते च रागो कुतु त्यागबुद्धि भविष्यति सा मुहानाम् । मात्सर्य प्रेत भवते उपपद्ययाती अथवा मनुष्य तद भोति दरिद्ररूपो ॥

examples.dm: At that time, the bodhisattva, knowing that sentient beings are impoverished, Will take delight in generosity and always give with great excellence. They feel more joy from giving away the four continents, beautifully adorned, as if they were a glob of spittle, Than they would from acquiring those continents.
examples.gm: Then, the bodhisattva, knowing that sentient beings are impoverished, Becomes intent on giving and always gives freely. The four continents, beautifully adorned, are like a glob of spit; Having given them away they become joyful, but attaining the continents is not like that.
examples.sa: तद बोधिसत्त्व इमि ज्ञात्व दरिद्रसत्त्वान् दानाधिमुक्त भवती सद मुक्तत्यागी । चत्वारि द्वीपि समलंकृतु खेटतुल्यं दत्त्वा उदग्र भवते न हि द्वीपलब्धो ॥

examples.dm: The wise and luminous bodhisattva, thinking, "May this gift be given To all sentient beings throughout the three realms of existence," Bestows the gift, and having done so, Dedicates it to supreme enlightenment for the benefit of all beings.
examples.gm: The wise and brilliant bodhisattva, [thinking], "Of the three states of existence, To all those sentient beings, however many there are, may this gift Be given!" Having thought thus, they give gifts, And also dedicate them to supreme awakening for the sake of beings.
examples.sa: दानं ददित्व विदु पण्डितु बोधिसत्त्वो यावन्ति सत्त्व त्रिभवे समन्वाहरित्वा । सर्वेषु तेषु भवते अयु दत्तदानं तं चाग्रबोधि परिणामयते जगार्थम् ॥

examples.dm: Having given a gift, one does not dwell upon it as a substantial thing; One never has any expectation for its karmic maturation. Those who are skilled in giving in such a way give everything; By giving even a small amount, it becomes vast and immeasurable.
examples.gm: Having given gifts, they do not abide in entities; They never have hope for a ripening result; Thus, being wise in giving, they let go of everything; Having given a little, it becomes much, immeasurable.
examples.sa: न च वस्तुनिश्रयु करोति ददित्व दानं विदु पाकु नैव प्रतिकाङ्क्षति सो कदाचित् । एवं त्यजित्व भवते विदु सर्वत्यागी अल्पं त्यजित्व लभते बहु अप्रमेयम् ॥

examples.dm: However many sentient beings there are without exception throughout the three realms of existence, If one were to take all of them as a basis for consideration, and if all of them, To the Knowers of the World—the Buddhas, Arhats, and Pratyekabuddhas— Were to give gifts for infinite eons while seeking the excellence of a Śrāvaka,
examples.gm: However many sentient beings there are without exception in the three states of existence, Taking them fully into consideration, if all of them To the Knowers of the World, the Buddhas, Arhats, and Pratyekabuddhas Give gifts for infinite eons, and properly seek the śrāvaka path—
examples.sa: यावन्त सत्त्व त्रिभवे निखिलेन अस्ति ते सर्वि दान ददयन्ति अनन्तकल्पान् । बुद्धानुलोकि विदु नार्हतिप्रत्ययानां यावन्ति श्रावकगुणान् परिकल्प स्थाने ॥

examples.dm: Yet a wise bodhisattva with skillful means Were to rejoice in the substance of those meritorious deeds, And fully dedicate it toward supreme, sublime enlightenment for the sake of sentient beings, By that complete dedication, one will outshine all living beings.
examples.gm: Whatever wise bodhisattva, skilled in means, Rejoices in their bases of meritorious actions, And fully dedicates them to supreme awakening for the sake of beings, By fully dedicating them, they outshine all beings.
examples.sa: यश् चो उपायकुशलो विदु बोधिसत्त्वो तेषां स पुण्यक्रियवस्त्वनुमोदयित्वा । सत्त्वार्थ अग्रवरबोधयि नामयेया अभिभोति सर्वजगती परिणामयुक्तो ॥

examples.dm: Yet a wise bodhisattva with skillful means Were to rejoice in the substance of those meritorious deeds, And fully dedicate it toward supreme, sublime enlightenment for the sake of sentient beings, By that complete dedication, one will outshine all living beings.
examples.gm: Whatever wise bodhisattva, skilled in means, Rejoices in their bases of meritorious actions, And fully dedicates them to supreme awakening for the sake of beings, By fully dedicating them, they outshine all beings.
examples.sa: यश् चो उपायकुशलो विदु बोधिसत्त्वो तेषां स पुण्यक्रियवस्त्वनुमोदयित्वा । सत्त्वार्थ अग्रवरबोधयि नामयेया अभिभोति सर्वजगती परिणामयुक्तो ॥

examples.dm: Yet a wise bodhisattva with skillful means Were to rejoice in the substance of those meritorious deeds, And fully dedicate it toward supreme, sublime enlightenment for the sake of sentient beings, By that complete dedication, one will outshine all living beings.
examples.gm: Whatever wise bodhisattva, skilled in means, Rejoices in their bases of meritorious actions, And fully dedicates them to supreme awakening for the sake of beings, By fully dedicating them, they outshine all beings.
examples.sa: यश् चो उपायकुशलो विदु बोधिसत्त्वो तेषां स पुण्यक्रियवस्त्वनुमोदयित्वा । सत्त्वार्थ अग्रवरबोधयि नामयेया अभिभोति सर्वजगती परिणामयुक्तो ॥

examples.dm: Even a massive heap of ordinary glass trinkets Is outshone by a single precious lapis lazuli gem; Likewise, all the vast heaps of generosity of all beings Are outshone by a bodhisattva who rejoices.
examples.gm: Even a great heap of imitation glass jewels Is completely outshone by a single precious lapis lazuli; Likewise, all the vast heaps of giving of all beings Are outshone by the rejoicing bodhisattva.
examples.sa: काचस्य वा मणिन राशि सिया महन्तो वैडूर्यरत्न अभिभोति स सर्व एको । एमेव सर्वजगती पृथु दानस्कन्धो अभिभोति सर्वपरिणामकु बोधिसत्त्वो ॥

examples.dm: Even a massive heap of ordinary glass trinkets Is outshone by a single precious lapis lazuli gem; Likewise, all the vast heaps of generosity of all beings Are outshone by a bodhisattva who rejoices.
examples.gm: Even a great heap of imitation glass jewels Is completely outshone by a single precious lapis lazuli; Likewise, all the vast heaps of giving of all beings Are outshone by the rejoicing bodhisattva.
examples.sa: काचस्य वा मणिन राशि सिया महन्तो वैडूर्यरत्न अभिभोति स सर्व एको । एमेव सर्वजगती पृथु दानस्कन्धो अभिभोति सर्वपरिणामकु बोधिसत्त्वो ॥

examples.dm: If a bodhisattva, having given a gift to living beings, Does not regard it as their own and has no attachment to the object, From that, the roots of virtue will grow to have great power, Like the bright orb of the waxing moon in a cloudless sky.
examples.gm: If the bodhisattva, having given gifts to beings, Does not make them "mine" and is unsparing of entities, Their roots of virtue will increase with great power, Like the radiant, cloudless moon disk in the waxing fortnight.
examples.sa: यदि बोधिसत्त्व ददमान जगस्य दानं ममतां न तत्र करयेन् न च वस्तुप्रेम । ततु वर्धते कुशलमूल महानुभावो चन्द्रो व तत्र प्रभमण्डलु शुक्लपक्षे ॥

examples.dm: The sixth chapter explains the gradual path. Through the generosity of a bodhisattva, the path to the realm of hungry spirits is cut off; It likewise eliminates poverty and all afflictions. When practiced, one will obtain an infinite expansion of resources; Through generosity, one brings sentient beings who are suffering to full maturity.
examples.gm: Chapter Six: Teaching the Gradual Training. By the bodhisattva's giving, the destiny of hungry ghosts is cut off; Poverty and likewise all afflictions are cut off; While practicing, they will obtain infinite, abundant wealth, And by giving, they fully ripen sentient beings who are suffering.
examples.sa: दानेन प्रेतगति छिन्दति बोधिसत्त्वो दारिद्रकं च छिनती तथ सर्वक्लेशान् । भोगांश् चनन्तविपुलां लभते चरन्तो दानेन सत्त्व परिपाचयि कृच्छ्रप्राप्तान् ॥

examples.dm: Through ethical discipline, one abandons the various states of animal existence, And by abandoning the eight unfree states, one always finds leisure. Through patience, one will attain a sublime, vast, and beautiful form; With a lovely golden complexion, one becomes worthy of being beheld by all beings.
examples.gm: By discipline, the nature of the manifold destinies of animals and The eight unfree states are abandoned, and leisure is always found. By patience, a fine, supreme, and vast form will be obtained, Golden-colored, beautiful, and worthy to be looked at by beings.
examples.sa: शीलेन तीर्यगति वर्जयि नेकरुपाम् अष्टौ च अक्षण क्षणां लभते स नित्यम् । क्षान्तीय रुप लभते परमं उदारं सुवर्णच्छवि प्रियु जगस्य उदीक्षणीयो ॥

examples.dm: Through diligence, virtuous qualities will not decline; One will find the treasury of the Victors, which is infinite primordial wisdom. Through meditative concentration, one abandons the base qualities of sensual desire; One fully accomplishes knowledge, supernormal powers, and meditative absorption.
examples.gm: By diligence, pure qualities will not diminish, And infinite pristine wisdom, the treasury of the Victors, will be found. By concentration, the despised qualities of desire are discarded, And knowledge, superknowledges, and samadhi are accomplished.
examples.sa: वीर्येण शुक्लगुण हानि न अभ्युपैति ज्ञानं अनन्त लभते जिनकोशगञ्जम् । ध्यानेन कामगुण उत्सृजते जुगुप्स्यान् विद्या अभिज्ञ अभिनिर्हरते समाधिम् ॥

examples.dm: Through wisdom, one thoroughly understands the nature of phenomena, And will perfectly transcend the three realms without exception. Having turned the precious wheel, that preeminent leader among men Teaches the Dharma to beings in order to bring suffering to an end.
examples.gm: By wisdom, having fully known the nature of phenomena, One will completely transcend the three realms without exception; The supreme leader of humans, having turned the precious wheel, Teaches the Dharma to beings in order to exhaust suffering.
examples.sa: प्रज्ञाय धर्मप्रकृती परिजानयित्वा त्रैधातुकान्त समतिक्रमते अपायान् । वर्तित्व चक्ररतनं पुरुषर्षभाणां देशेति धर्म जगती दुखसंक्षयाये ॥

examples.dm: Teaching of the Dharmakāya
examples.gm: Teaching on the Dharmakāya

examples.dm: The eighth chapter: teaching the Dharmakāya. One fully embraces the pure realm and the purity of sentient beings; One fully embraces the lineage of the Buddha and the lineage of the Dharma; Likewise, one fully embraces the lineage of the Saṅgha and all phenomena.
examples.gm: Chapter Eight: Teaching the Dharmakāya. Fully upholds perfectly pure fields and pure sentient beings; Fully upholds the Buddha lineage and also the Dharma lineage; Likewise fully upholds the Sangha lineage and all dharmas.

examples.dm: As the supreme physician who heals the ailments of wandering beings, He has spoken this teaching on wisdom, which possesses the path to enlightenment; This path to awakening is titled "The Collection of Precious Qualities," And is taught so that all sentient beings may attain it.
examples.gm: By the supreme physician who heals the diseases of beings, This teaching of wisdom, endowed with the path to awakening, was taught; Its name is the Collection of Precious Qualities, the path to awakening; This path was explained in order for all sentient beings to obtain it.
examples.sa: वैद्योत्तमो जगति रोगचिकित्सकारी प्रज्ञोपदेश कथितो अयु बोधिमार्गो । नामेन रत्नगुणसंचय बोधिमार्गः तं सर्वसत्त्व इतु मार्गतु प्राप्नुवन्ति ॥

examples.sa: ये धर्मा हेतुप्रभवा हेतुं तेषां तथागतो ह्यवदत् । तेषां च यो निरोध एवं वादी महाश्रमणः ॥ लेखकप्रशस्तिः । योऽसौ धर्मं सुगतगदितं पठते भक्तिभावान् मात्राहीनं कथम् अपि पदं पादगाथाक्षरं वा । जिह्वादोषैः पवनचरितैः श्लेष्मदोषप्रचारैर् यूयं बुद्धाः सुभवनगता बोधिसत्त्वाः क्षमध्वम् ॥ समाप्तम् ।शुभम् ॥
